raw: {"analysis":"HJG provides a more practical and executable plan, correctly identifying that a feature flag toggle is the primary rollback mechanism rather than unnecessarily invoking a full database rollback. HJG also properly scopes CI to targeted suites to control cost, and correctly avoids the legacy audit logger. SSM has some good detail on CI budgeting and downstream impact verification, but its rollback plan confusingly defaults to full database rollback for what is a logic/config change, and its lane structure introduces unnecessary serialization between spec and implementation.","verdict":"HJG"}
